source.sqlReaderQuery: DECLARE @MAX_DATE DATETIME SET @MAX_DATE=? ;with base_CMENR_NEW_CASES as  (select  	  NEW_CASE.BATCH_NUM 	 ,NEW_CASE.CASE_ID 	 ,NEW_CASE.MEME_CK 	 ,NEW_CASE.CASE_NAME 	 ,NEW_CASE.SUBSCRIBER_ID 	 ,G.GROUP_CK 	 ,NEW_CASE.GROUP_ID 	 ,NEW_CASE.CREATE_DATE      ,CASE WHEN NEW_CASE.CASE_ID LIKE 'C%' OR NEW_CASE.CASE_ID LIKE 'EC%' THEN 'CCM'  		   WHEN NEW_CASE.CASE_ID LIKE 'P%' OR NEW_CASE.CASE_ID LIKE 'EP%' THEN 'PDM'        ELSE 'UNK' END CM_PROGRAM 	    ,(CASE WHEN CT.CASE_TYPE_DESC LIKE '%BH%' THEN 'BH'        WHEN CT.CASE_TYPE_DESC LIKE '%PH%' THEN 'PH'        ELSE 'UNK'        END) CM_CASE_TYPE        ,PL.PLAN_ID 	    ,PR.PRODUCT_ID        ,G.GROUP_MCTR_TYPE        ,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(Partition by NEW_CASE.SUBSCRIBER_ID ORDER BY NEW_CASE.BATCH_NUM DESC,NEW_CASE.CREATE_DATE DESC,NEW_CASE.CASE_ID DESC) AS ROW_NUM   from [APP_RPTS].CMENR_NEW_CASES_STG NEW_CASE 			LEFT JOIN CAREADVANCE_DM.DW_FACT_MEMBER_ELIGIBILITY ME (NOLOCK) ON NEW_CASE.MEME_CK = ME.MEME_CK  					   AND  CAST(DATEPART(YYYY,NEW_CASE.CREATE_DATE) AS [CHAR](4)) 					   + RIGHT('0' + CAST(DATEPART(M,NEW_CASE.CREATE_DATE) AS [VARCHAR](2)),2)   					   + RIGHT('0' + CAST(DATEPART(D,NEW_CASE.CREATE_DATE) AS [VARCHAR](2)),2) BETWEEN ME.EFF_DATE AND ME.TERM_DATE 			LEFT JOIN CAREADVANCE_DM.DW_DIM_MARKET MKT (NOLOCK) ON ME.MARKET_KEY = MKT.MARKET_KEY 			LEFT JOIN CAREADVANCE_DM.DW_DIM_GROUP G (NOLOCK) ON MKT.GROUP_CK = G.GROUP_CK 			LEFT JOIN CAREADVANCE_DM.DW_DIM_PLAN PL (NOLOCK) ON MKT.PLAN_KEY = PL.PLAN_KEY  			LEFT JOIN CAREADVANCE_DM.DW_DIM_PRODUCT PR (NOLOCK) ON MKT.PRODUCT_KEY = PR.PRODUCT_KEY 			LEFT JOIN CAREADVANCE_DM.DW_DIM_CASE_TYPE CT (NOLOCK) ON  NEW_CASE.CASE_TYPE= CT.CASE_TYPE_ID   Where log_date between  CONVERT(DATETIME, CONVERT(CHAR(8), @MAX_DATE, 112)   + ' ' + '22:00:00.000' )       AND CONVERT(DATETIME, CONVERT(CHAR(8), GETDATE(), 112)   + ' ' + '22:00:00.000' ) )   select    NC.CASE_ID  ,NC.MEME_CK   ,CAST(DATEPART(YYYY,NC.CREATE_DATE) AS [CHAR](4))        + RIGHT('0' + CAST(DATEPART(M,NC.CREATE_DATE) AS [VARCHAR](2)),2)          + RIGHT('0' + CAST(DATEPART(D,NC.CREATE_DATE) AS [VARCHAR](2)),2) as CREATE_DATE   ,NC.GROUP_ID  ,NC.PLAN_ID   ,NC.PRODUCT_ID  ,CAST(NC.CASE_NAME AS NVARCHAR(100)) as CASE_NAME  ,NC.CM_PROGRAM   ,NC.CM_CASE_TYPE  ,NC.GROUP_CK as GRGR_CK  ,NC.SUBSCRIBER_ID as SBSB_ID  ,NC.BATCH_NUM  ,getdate() as LoadDate  from base_CMENR_NEW_CASES NC Where ROW_NUM=1  AND GROUP_MCTR_TYPE = 'MDCD'  AND SUBSTRING(NC.PLAN_ID,1,2) NOT IN ('CO','CT','ME','NH','NM')

USE [PDS_2008]
GO

MERGE INTO [dbo].[PDS_CALLLIST_137_HISTORY] WITH (HOLDLOCK) AS target
USING 
(
select 
	  [CALLLIST_137_STAGING_CASE_ID] as CASE_ID
     ,[CALLLIST_137_STAGING_MEME_CK] as MEME_CK
     ,[CALLLIST_137_STAGING_CREATE_DATE] as CREATE_DATE     
     ,[CALLLIST_137_STAGING_GROUP_ID] as GROUP_ID     
     ,[CALLLIST_137_STAGING_PLAN_ID] as PLAN_ID          
	 ,[CALLLIST_137_STAGING_PRODUCT_ID] as PRODUCT_ID   
     ,[CALLLIST_137_STAGING_CASE_NAME] as CASE_NAME          
     ,[CALLLIST_137_STAGING_CM_PROGRAM] as CM_PROGRAM  
	 ,[CALLLIST_137_STAGING_CM_CASE_TYPE] as CM_CASE_TYPE    
	 ,[CALLLIST_137_STAGING_GRGR_CK] as GRGR_CK
     ,[CALLLIST_137_STAGING_SBSB_ID] as SBSB_ID
	 ,[CALLLIST_137_STAGING_LOAD_DATE] as LOAD_DATE
	 ,[CALLLIST_137_STAGING_BATCH_NUM] as BATCH_NUM
 FROM [dbo].[PDS_CALLLIST_137_STAGING] S
) AS source
    ON target.[CALLLIST_137_HISTORY_CASE_ID] = source.CASE_ID
WHEN MATCHED THEN 
    UPDATE SET 
      target.[CALLLIST_137_HISTORY_MEME_CK]= source.MEME_CK
     ,target.[CALLLIST_137_HISTORY_CREATE_DATE]= source.CREATE_DATE     
     ,target.[CALLLIST_137_HISTORY_GROUP_ID]= source.GROUP_ID     
     ,target.[CALLLIST_137_HISTORY_PLAN_ID] = source.PLAN_ID
	 ,target.[CALLLIST_137_HISTORY_PRODUCT_ID] = source.PRODUCT_ID
     ,target.[CALLLIST_137_HISTORY_CASE_NAME] = source.CASE_NAME
     ,target.[CALLLIST_137_HISTORY_CM_PROGRAM] = source.CM_PROGRAM     
	 ,target.[CALLLIST_137_HISTORY_CM_CASE_TYPE] = source.CM_CASE_TYPE 
	 ,target.[CALLLIST_137_HISTORY_GRGR_CK] = source.GRGR_CK
     ,target.[CALLLIST_137_HISTORY_SBSB_ID] = source.SBSB_ID
	 ,target.[CALLLIST_137_HISTORY_LOAD_DATE] = source.LOAD_DATE	 		
	 ,target.[CALLLIST_137_HISTORY_BATCH_NUM] = source.BATCH_NUM
WHEN NOT MATCHED BY TARGET THEN
    INSERT ([CALLLIST_137_HISTORY_CASE_ID],
     [CALLLIST_137_HISTORY_MEME_CK],
     [CALLLIST_137_HISTORY_CREATE_DATE],     
     [CALLLIST_137_HISTORY_GROUP_ID],     
     [CALLLIST_137_HISTORY_PLAN_ID],
	 [CALLLIST_137_HISTORY_PRODUCT_ID],
     [CALLLIST_137_HISTORY_CASE_NAME],
     [CALLLIST_137_HISTORY_CM_PROGRAM],  
	 [CALLLIST_137_HISTORY_CM_CASE_TYPE],   
	 [CALLLIST_137_HISTORY_GRGR_CK],
     [CALLLIST_137_HISTORY_SBSB_ID],	 
	 [CALLLIST_137_HISTORY_LOAD_DATE],
	  [CALLLIST_137_HISTORY_BATCH_NUM])
    VALUES  (	
	 CASE_ID		
     ,MEME_CK
     ,CREATE_DATE     
     ,GROUP_ID     
     ,PLAN_ID         
	 ,PRODUCT_ID 
     ,CASE_NAME          
     ,CM_PROGRAM     
	 ,CM_CASE_TYPE
	 ,GRGR_CK
     ,SBSB_ID
	 ,LOAD_DATE
	 ,BATCH_NUM);

GO

SELECT COUNT(CM.CALLLISTMASTER_IID)
FROM (
	SELECT MAX(CD.CALLLISTDATE_IID) AS MAX_CALLLISTDATE_IID 
	FROM PDS_CALLLIST CL INNER JOIN PDS_CALLLISTDATE CD ON CD.CALLLISTDATE_CALLLIST_IID = CL.CALLLIST_IID AND CL.CALLLIST_CD = '137'
) MAXCD
	INNER JOIN PDS_CALLLISTMASTER CM ON MAXCD.MAX_CALLLISTDATE_IID = CM.CALLLISTMASTER_CALLLISTDATE_IID
	INNER JOIN PDS_MEMBER M ON CM.CALLLISTMASTER_ENTITY_IID = M.MEMBER_IID
	INNER JOIN PDS_CALLLIST_137_HISTORY H ON CM.CALLLISTMASTER_EXTRADATA_IID = H.CALLLIST_137_HISTORY_CASE_IID
	INNER JOIN PDS_CALLLIST_137_STAGING S ON M.MEMBER_MEMBERNUMBER = S.CALLLIST_137_STAGING_SBSB_ID + '00'
		AND H.CALLLIST_137_HISTORY_CASE_ID <> S.CALLLIST_137_STAGING_CASE_ID
		AND H.CALLLIST_137_HISTORY_CREATE_DATE < S.CALLLIST_137_STAGING_CREATE_DATE

SELECT COUNT(CM.CALLLISTMASTER_IID)
FROM (
	SELECT MAX(CD.CALLLISTDATE_IID) AS MAX_CALLLISTDATE_IID 
	FROM PDS_CALLLIST CL INNER JOIN PDS_CALLLISTDATE CD ON CD.CALLLISTDATE_CALLLIST_IID = CL.CALLLIST_IID AND CL.CALLLIST_CD = '137'
) MAXCD
	INNER JOIN PDS_CALLLISTMASTER CM ON MAXCD.MAX_CALLLISTDATE_IID = CM.CALLLISTMASTER_CALLLISTDATE_IID
	INNER JOIN PDS_MEMBER M ON CM.CALLLISTMASTER_ENTITY_IID = M.MEMBER_IID
	INNER JOIN PDS_CALLLIST_137_HISTORY H ON CM.CALLLISTMASTER_EXTRADATA_IID = H.CALLLIST_137_HISTORY_CASE_IID
	INNER JOIN PDS_CALLLIST_137_STAGING S ON M.MEMBER_MEMBERNUMBER = S.CALLLIST_137_STAGING_SBSB_ID + '00'
		AND H.CALLLIST_137_HISTORY_CASE_ID <> S.CALLLIST_137_STAGING_CASE_ID
		AND H.CALLLIST_137_HISTORY_CREATE_DATE < S.CALLLIST_137_STAGING_CREATE_DATE

scripts.text:
UPDATE CM 
SET CALLLISTMASTER_EXTRADATA_IID = NEWCASES.NEW_CASE_IID
FROM (
	SELECT CM.CALLLISTMASTER_IID,H2.CALLLIST_137_HISTORY_CASE_IID AS NEW_CASE_IID,H.CALLLIST_137_HISTORY_SBSB_ID AS MEMBER_SBSB_ID,H.CALLLIST_137_HISTORY_CASE_ID AS OLD_CASE_ID,H.CALLLIST_137_HISTORY_CREATE_DATE AS OLD_CASE_CREATION_DATE,S.CALLLIST_137_STAGING_CASE_ID AS NEW_CASE_ID,S.CALLLIST_137_STAGING_CREATE_DATE AS NEW_CASE_CREATION_DATE,ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY H.CALLLIST_137_HISTORY_SBSB_ID ORDER BY S.CALLLIST_137_STAGING_CREATE_DATE DESC,S.CALLLIST_137_STAGING_CASE_ID DESC) AS ROWNUM
	FROM (
		SELECT MAX(CD.CALLLISTDATE_IID) AS MAX_CALLLISTDATE_IID 
		FROM PDS_CALLLIST CL INNER JOIN PDS_CALLLISTDATE CD ON CD.CALLLISTDATE_CALLLIST_IID = CL.CALLLIST_IID AND CL.CALLLIST_CD = '137'
	) MAXCD
		INNER JOIN PDS_CALLLISTMASTER CM ON MAXCD.MAX_CALLLISTDATE_IID = CM.CALLLISTMASTER_CALLLISTDATE_IID
		INNER JOIN PDS_MEMBER M ON CM.CALLLISTMASTER_ENTITY_IID = M.MEMBER_IID
		INNER JOIN PDS_CALLLIST_137_HISTORY H ON CM.CALLLISTMASTER_EXTRADATA_IID = H.CALLLIST_137_HISTORY_CASE_IID
		INNER JOIN PDS_CALLLIST_137_STAGING S ON M.MEMBER_MEMBERNUMBER = S.CALLLIST_137_STAGING_SBSB_ID + '00'
			AND H.CALLLIST_137_HISTORY_CASE_ID <> S.CALLLIST_137_STAGING_CASE_ID
			AND H.CALLLIST_137_HISTORY_CREATE_DATE < S.CALLLIST_137_STAGING_CREATE_DATE
		INNER JOIN PDS_CALLLIST_137_HISTORY H2 ON H2.CALLLIST_137_HISTORY_CASE_ID = S.CALLLIST_137_STAGING_CASE_ID
) NEWCASES
	INNER JOIN PDS_CALLLISTMASTER CM ON CM.CALLLISTMASTER_IID = NEWCASES.CALLLISTMASTER_IID
WHERE NEWCASES.ROWNUM = 1

			LEFT JOIN CAREADVANCE_DM.DW_DIM_PRODUCT PR (NOLOCK) ON MKT.PRODUCT_KEY = PR.PRODUCT_KEY
			LEFT JOIN CAREADVANCE_DM.DW_DIM_CASE_TYPE CT (NOLOCK) ON  NEW_CASE.CASE_TYPE= CT.CASE_TYPE_ID
  Where BATCH_NUM > 11/9/2020 2:06:40 PM) 
select 
  NC.CASE_ID
 ,NC.MEME_CK
  ,CAST(DATEPART(YYYY,NC.CREATE_DATE) AS [CHAR](4))
       + RIGHT('0' + CAST(DATEPART(M,NC.CREATE_DATE) AS [VARCHAR](2)),2)  
       + RIGHT('0' + CAST(DATEPART(D,NC.CREATE_DATE) AS [VARCHAR](2)),2) as CREATE_DATE 
 ,NC.GROUP_ID
 ,NC.PLAN_ID
  ,NC.PRODUCT_ID
 ,CAST(NC.CASE_NAME AS NVARCHAR(100)) as CASE_NAME
 ,NC.CM_PROGRAM
  ,NC.CM_CASE_TYPE
 ,NC.GROUP_CK as GRGR_CK
 ,NC.SUBSCRIBER_ID as SBSB_ID
 ,NC.BATCH_NUM
 ,getdate() as LoadDate
 from base_CMENR_NEW_CASES NC
Where ROW_NUM=1 
AND GROUP_MCTR_TYPE = 'MDCD' 
AND SUBSTRING(NC.PLAN_ID,1,2) NOT IN ('CO','CT','ME','NH','NM')'
